gloss: to totter; to stagger; to wobble

definitions.gloss: to totter; to stagger; to wobble; to walk unsteadily
definitions.explanation: To move or walk in an unsteady, shaky manner, as if about to fall. Describes the motion of someone weak, dizzy, or unbalanced.

examples.japanese: ⟦よろよろ→よろよろ：05368_yoroyoro⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{歩|ある}く→歩く：00538_aruku⟧。
⟦{酔|よ}っ{払|ぱら}い→酔っ払い：09429_yopparai⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧よろよろし⟦ながら→ながら：10530_nagara⟧⟦{帰|かえ}って→帰る：00508_kaeru⟧いった。
⟦{高熱|こうねつ}→高熱：14649_kounetsu⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{体|からだ}→体：00784_karada⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧よろよろして、⟦まっすぐ→まっすぐ：00866_massugu⟧⟦{歩|ある}けなかった→歩く：00538_aruku⟧。
examples.english: My body was so wobbly from the high fever that I couldn't walk straight.

notes:
An onomatopoeic/mimetic word (⟦オノマトペ→オノマトペ：22607_onomatope⟧) describing unsteady, tottering movement. The reduplication of よろ emphasizes the repeated, wavering nature of the motion.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦よろよろ→よろよろ：05368_yoroyoro⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{歩|ある}く→歩く：00538_aruku⟧: to walk unsteadily
- よろよろし⟦ながら→ながら：10530_nagara⟧: while staggering
- ⟦よろよろ→よろよろ：05368_yoroyoro⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{立|た}ち{上|あ}がる→立ち上がる：02128_tachiagaru⟧: to stand up unsteadily
- ⟦{足元|あしもと}→足元：04096_ashimoto⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧よろよろする: one's footing is unsteady

FORMS:
Used both as a ⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ verb (よろよろする) and as an adverb with the particle ⟦と→と：00512_to⟧ (⟦よろよろ→よろよろ：05368_yoroyoro⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧). The adverbial form is often combined with verbs of motion like ⟦{歩|ある}く→歩く：00538_aruku⟧, ⟦{進|すす}む→進む：01225_susumu⟧, or ⟦{立|た}つ→立つ：00758_tatsu⟧.

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦ふらふらする→ふらふらする：21629_furafurasuru⟧: to be dizzy, to stagger — emphasizes dizziness or lightheadedness; ⟦よろよろ→よろよろ：05368_yoroyoro⟧ focuses more on weak, tottering movement
- ⟦よたよた→よたよた：28826_yotayota⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to totter — similar to ⟦よろよろ→よろよろ：05368_yoroyoro⟧ but implies even more weakness or frailty, often associated with the elderly
- ⟦よろめく→よろめく：06971_yoromeku⟧: to stagger — a verb with similar meaning but without the mimetic repetition
